document_title: Process Transfer Plan — A-Mab Drug Substance
schema_note: Blocks validate against nlp_reports app/models; parameter_type, document_type, QualityAttribute criticality fields, StudyDesign and DesignSpace are local extensions (see schema_extensions_used).
out_of_schema_notes: Transfer plan spans the whole process train; entities are the sites, the Step 3-10 process steps and the CQAs preserved across the transfer.
The distinctive objects are the TransferGap entries (transfer_has_gap assertions); each gap is anchored twice, on its §8 narrative statement and on its row of the gap table.

Strictly prospective: the document reports no characterization outcome, so the annex carries no parameter classification, no capability and no design space. The only counts asserted are the prospective study-type allocation (multivariate / univariate).

statements.statement_text: PTP-001 governs the transfer of the A-Mab drug-substance manufacturing process from the sending development site to the receiving commercial drug-substance site.

source_references.quote: This plan governs the transfer of the A-Mab drug substance manufacturing process

statements.statement_text: PTP-001 is the parent document of the A-Mab process characterization package: RA-001, PCMP-001, the per-step plans and reports and PCMR-001 all derive from it.

source_references.quote: This plan is the parent document of the A-Mab process characterization package

statements.statement_text: The plan is strictly prospective: it records no characterization result and makes no claim about the outcome of any study it commissions.

source_references.quote: It records no characterization result

statements.statement_text: The transfer covers the eight drug-substance unit operations (Steps 3 to 10), from the production bioreactor to the final ultrafiltration and diafiltration step.

source_references.quote: from the production bioreactor through the final ultrafiltration and diafiltration step

statements.statement_text: Technology transfer under ICH Q10 is the transfer of product and process knowledge, so that the receiving site can realise the product.

source_references.quote: the transfer of product and process knowledge between development and manufacturing

statements.statement_text: The characterization scope that supports the transfer assigns 22 of the 37 process parameters to multivariate study and 15 to univariate study, on the basis set out in RA-001.

source_references.quote: 22 are assigned to multivariate study and 15 to univariate study

statements.statement_text: The process description delivered at transfer carries set-points and proposed normal operating ranges only: no proven acceptable range and no parameter classification exists when the plan takes effect.

source_references.section_title: Transfer of the process, methods and control strategy
heading_path: Transfer of the process, methods and control strategy
source_references.quote: It does not carry proven acceptable ranges (PARs), and it does not carry parameter classifications

statements.statement_text: Six gaps separate what the receiving site holds today from what it needs in order to manufacture A-Mab under an approved control strategy, and none is closed by this plan.

source_references.quote: None of the six is closed by this plan

statements.statement_text: Commercial-scale confirmation is a Stage 2 PPQ campaign that confirms, and does not establish, the process design recorded in the Stage 1 characterization package.

source_references.quote: PPQ is Stage 2 of the process validation lifecycle, and it confirms at scale the process design established in Stage 1

transfer_gaps.description: No point in the proposed design space will have been run at commercial scale when the characterization package completes: the studies are executed on scale-down models at the sending site and the engineering and PPQ batches are run at set-point.
transfer_gaps.impact: A scale-dependent effect at the edge of the characterized region (for example pCO2 accumulation at commercial working volume, or a longer mixing time in a larger vessel) would not appear in the characterization data at all.
transfer_gaps.mitigation: Qualification of every scale-down model under SOP-1001 with statistical comparison of performance across scales, followed by engineering runs and PPQ batches at set-point; owned by MSAT at both sites, evidenced by the SOP-1001 qualification records and PCMR-001.

source_references.quote: No point in the proposed design space will have been run at commercial scale

source_references.table_title: Transfer gaps, closing actions, owners and the evidence that closes each
source_references.quote: Design space not confirmed at commercial scale

transfer_gaps.description: None of the validated analytical methods has been executed for A-Mab at the receiving-site laboratory.
transfer_gaps.impact: In-process and release testing cannot be performed at the receiving site when the plan takes effect, and method variance is part of the variance that the capability projections in PCMR-001 must account for.
transfer_gaps.mitigation: The method-transfer sequence of §6.2, with comparative precision and accuracy criteria per method and an approved transfer report per AMV; Analytical Development owns the protocol and receiving-site Quality Control owns the execution. Until each report is approved the affected testing stays at the sending site.

source_references.quote: In-process and release testing cannot therefore be performed there when this plan takes effect

source_references.table_title: Transfer gaps, closing actions, owners and the evidence that closes each
source_references.quote: Analytical methods not qualified at the receiving site

transfer_gaps.description: The control strategy that the receiving site must implement does not yet exist: every parameter carries a proposed set-point and a proposed normal operating range, but none carries a final classification and no proven acceptable range has been established.
transfer_gaps.impact: The master batch record cannot be issued in its final form and PPQ cannot start, so the transfer cannot be completed on the process description alone.
transfer_gaps.mitigation: The document sequence of Table 2 (RA-001, then the plans PCP-003 to PCP-010, then the reports PCR-003 to PCR-010, then PCMR-001), followed by classification under SOP-4001 and revision of the batch record; MSAT owns the sequence and Quality Assurance approves its output.

source_references.quote: The control strategy that the receiving site must implement does not yet exist

source_references.table_title: Transfer gaps, closing actions, owners and the evidence that closes each
source_references.quote: No parameter classification or control strategy

transfer_gaps.description: Viral clearance cannot be measured in the commercial facility: spiking studies are performed only at scale-down and under containment, so the clearance claimed for the low-pH hold, for anion exchange and for virus filtration rests entirely on scale-down data.
transfer_gaps.impact: The cumulative XMuLV and MVM claims are supported by a modular argument across three steps and by the qualification of three scale-down models, and not by any commercial-scale measurement.
transfer_gaps.mitigation: The scale-down models for Steps 6, 8 and 9 are qualified to worst-case commercial conditions and the modular clearance studies are run to ICH Q5A; the receiving site then demonstrates in the engineering runs that it can hold the governing parameters of those steps.

source_references.quote: Viral clearance cannot be measured in the commercial facility

source_references.table_title: Transfer gaps, closing actions, owners and the evidence that closes each
source_references.quote: Viral clearance measurable only at scale-down

transfer_gaps.description: The Protein A capture step cannot inherit its ranges from platform data: RA-004 assessed the alternate Protein A resin and concluded that independent characterization is required, with no bridging from the platform data that supports the other steps of the train.
transfer_gaps.impact: The operating ranges of the capture step, and the leached Protein A attribute that the step sets, have no prior-knowledge basis and must be established experimentally before the transfer can complete.
transfer_gaps.mitigation: Full characterization of the step in PCP-005 and PCR-005, including the resin life-cycle and sanitization conditions governed by SOP-2008; Process Development at the sending site owns the action.

source_references.quote: The Protein A capture step cannot inherit its ranges from platform data

source_references.table_title: Transfer gaps, closing actions, owners and the evidence that closes each
source_references.quote: Protein A resin has no platform bridging (RA-004)

transfer_gaps.description: The receiving site has no execution history for this process: no operator there has run an A-Mab batch, no buffer has been prepared at commercial scale to the A-Mab formulations, and the buffer hold times that the chromatography steps depend on have not been verified at that scale.
transfer_gaps.impact: The impact is concentrated in the first batches, where an execution error or an out-of-specification buffer lot would move the conductivity and pH of the chromatography loads, which are the governing parameters of the polishing and viral steps.
transfer_gaps.mitigation: Training against the transferred procedures, buffer preparation and expiry verification under SOP-2103, at least one engineering run per unit operation, and a readiness review before PPQ; receiving-site Manufacturing owns the action with MSAT support.

source_references.quote: The receiving site has no execution history for this process

source_references.table_title: Transfer gaps, closing actions, owners and the evidence that closes each
source_references.quote: No execution history at the receiving site
